PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Product judgment.
Hands-on execution.

Product Manager with 3 years in product roles and 2.5+ years across growth and GTM for B2B SaaS, healthtech, and professional services. As Co-owner and Product Head at MagnetizeX, I lead AI-powered LinkedIn products from customer discovery and problem framing through PRDs, MVP scoping, beta launch, and iteration.

I build working prototypes with the Claude API, Chrome extensions using Manifest V3, and modern low-code stacks. I keep V1 focused on the core customer problem, using early evidence to decide what earns a place on the roadmap.

PRODUCT STRATEGY IN PRACTICE

Product case
challenges.

Independent portfolio case studies with proposed solutions and success metrics.

01

Choose Together

A shared, three-film shortlist helps two adults agree on what to watch. The proposal tests faster, mutually accepted starts while protecting each viewer’s preferences.

Discovery · Shared decisions

View case study↗
02

Long-Stay Confidence

A Long-stay brief brings work setup, payment timing, and cancellation exposure into one decision. The proposal tests better guest matches while protecting host earnings.

Marketplace · Trust

View case study↗
03

A Calmer Pickup

Meetpoint gives riders and drivers a shared plan from terminal exit to car. The proposal pairs clear pickup guidance with readiness signals and airport-specific recovery.

Rider experience · Operations

View case study↗
04

Signals That Matter

A proposed RMS dashboard separates successful pricing work from apparent inactivity. It prioritizes evidence-backed interventions while keeping customer trust concerns visible.

B2B SaaS · Product adoption

View case study↗
05

Premium, Proven First

A proposed Premium Session lets free listeners feel the value before paying. Small UPI passes create a prepaid upgrade path, measured by retained contribution margin.

Growth · Monetization

View case study↗
06

Coin Clarity

Coin Clarity makes usable balance, eligibility, and expiry clear before payment. The proposal aims to improve confident redemption while preserving existing reward rules.

Loyalty · Retention

View case study↗
